interpretation.what_improved: The local reader preserved the alternative-plus-limit relationship that every full-conversation exploration design missed.
interpretation.what_deterministic_code_contributed: Stable focal/context citation boundaries, exact source identity, record-level admission, duplicate identity, terminal custody, and replay.
